name: ocha-lidya-whatsapp-bot
description: Ocha Lidya WhatsApp bot with resilient WhatsApp reconnection, QR/pairing-code login, cached group metadata, PN contact indexing, and multi-key provider validation, Nexora persistent per-user website repositories, project task memory, encrypted lifelong per-user conversation vaults, Git-backed revisions and opt-in ZIP delivery, quoted AI reply chains, boosted low-latency inference, prioritized command reply sessions, group metadata navigation, message test lab, independent master runners with owner-controlled workload warnings, CTA-copy confirmation, AI-review switch, and scope-aware WhatsApp-send risk classification, secure redacted logs, runtime-safe filesystem watchers, per-group interaction controls, and message receipt monitoring, public creator identity, adaptive greetings, persistent unbounded XP/rank progression with unique-content trust milestones, relationship-aware persona state, and profile card rendering, and provider-aware multi-provider AI fallback with autonomous 24-hour model catalogue discovery, owner group joining, automatic participating-group inventory reconciliation, in-group owner-only mute activation, live plugin-registry command menus, branded menu banner, and expanded XP streak and achievement profile cards, global configurable menu pagination and descriptions, adaptive per-command cooldown, persistent anti-spam temporary sanctions, and AI-assisted staged plugin authoring, private group rental checkout with verified WhatsApp-admin routing, tiered member limits, weighted rolling 24-hour quotas, verifiable reviews, owner-routed customer support tickets, manual payment evidence review, group admin tools, automated private reminders native-flow registry support, YouTube text-only paginated carousel search, alias-safe MP3/MP4 resolution downloads, and isolated audio-only music jobs, adaptive intent routing, encrypted owner feature-request backlog, explicit opt-in AI interactive messages, and capability-aware conversation orchestration, persistent private Tic-Tac-Toe game with Minimax, encrypted per-user state recovery, strict legal move validation, natural-language game routing, and external GitHub-managed NADI operational self-state component connected through loopback HTTP without embedding Python source in the bot repository, plus ACIE immutable contribution intake, isolated provider orchestration, governance-gated command generation and virtual plugin-loader integration
